response.original_text:
Fishermen catch fish in Laguna de Bay along the Taguig City shoreline on Sunday.
Senator Ping Lacson bared new findings from the Philippine Reclamation Authority showing that unauthorized reclamation in Laguna de Bay along the Taguig segment has reached 170 hectares – double his initial estimate of 85 hectares. (Photos by Ryan Baldemor/The Philippine STAR)
RELATED: https://tinyurl.com/53ny54kr
